name: workflow
description: Spec-driven delivery pipeline: /spec (PRD) -> /taskplan (partitioned plan) -> /implement (parallel orchestrated build; /implement-orca for Orca-dispatched workers) -> /cleanup (PR, CI, merge, teardown). Plus ticket-level execution over GitHub Issues: /frontier fans a wide graph out to parallel Orca worktrees (one PR per ticket), /caravan walks a mostly-linear graph on one integration branch (one PR total). And /project-kit project scaffolding.
